name: Swiss Editorial
tagline: Red, black and a strict grid. Headlines that slide up out of masks.
description: International Typographic Style for product updates, reports and manifestos. Heavy grotesk headlines on warm paper, a visible 120px margin grid, one red accent block, and hard cuts between numbered sections.

rhythm.notes: Lines land 0.13s apart; the accent line lands last, ~0.3s later.

guide:
- Keep a 120px outer margin and draw the grid lines (2px #111) in the first 0.7s; they stay for the whole video.
- One idea per scene. Headline max 3 lines; the last line (the payoff) is red #e30613.
- Every headline line sits in an overflow:hidden mask and rises from yPercent 105 with power4.out, 0.7s, ~0.13s stagger.
- Use exactly one red geometric block per scene. Never use gradients, shadows or rounded corners.
- Numbered sections (01/02/03) go in equal columns separated by 2px rules.
- Cut between scenes; the outro is a full-frame red wipe (scaleX 0→1, expo.inOut, 0.55s) with paper-colored text.
